name: io.github.zepgram/toyota
description: MCP server for MyToyota Europe (read-only by default): fuel, range, location, trips, EV share, health.

environmentVariables.name: TOYOTA_VIN
environmentVariables.description: VIN selector when several vehicles share the account

environmentVariables.name: TOYOTA_BRAND
environmentVariables.description: T for Toyota (default), L for Lexus

environmentVariables.name: TOYOTA_USE_METRIC
environmentVariables.description: true (default) for km/L, false for miles/gallons

environmentVariables.name: TOYOTA_OPEN_DATA
environmentVariables.description: osm adds worldwide addresses, fr adds French addresses and fuel prices (default off)

environmentVariables.name: TOYOTA_REMOTE_COMMANDS
environmentVariables.description: true registers the remote command tools (default false)
